product.name: PayTabs Payment Gateway
product.description: A multi-channel payment gateway enabling merchants to accept payments online, via mobile, and in-store with multiple currency and payment method support.

identifier.value: PayTabs Prepaid Card Issuance & Program Management

product.name: PayTabs Prepaid Card Issuance & Program Management
product.description: A service for businesses to issue and manage branded prepaid cards in multiple currencies, including virtual and physical cards, with lifecycle management and transaction security.

product.name: PayTabs Payment Orchestration Platform
product.description: An AI-powered payment orchestration platform that enables businesses and financial institutions to customize, manage, and monitor payment processes with compliance and reporting features.

product.name: PayTabs Paymes Social Commerce Platform
product.description: A platform for freelancers and small businesses to create digital stores and collect payments via social media using payment links and QR codes.

product.name: PayTabs Soft POS Solution
product.description: A software-based point-of-sale solution that transforms smartphones or tablets into payment acceptance devices for card transactions on the go.

identifier.value: PayTabs Digital School Fee Payment Solutions

product.name: PayTabs Digital School Fee Payment Solutions
product.description: A digital payment system for educational institutions to collect school or university fees online with invoicing, reminders, and reporting.
